description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for health checking within the Gateway service, including methods for retrieving service timeouts and cluster role configurations, along with nested enums specifying default configuration values.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Defines methods for getting health check timeout and cluster role configuration.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig.HealthCheckConfigValue
classes.description: Enum holding default values and config paths for health check configuration parameters.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig.ClusterRolesConfig
classes.description: Interface that specifies cluster role related health check configurations.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfig.ClusterRolesConfig.ClusterRolesConfigValue
classes.description: Enum holding default values and config paths for cluster roles configuration.

methods.name: getServiceTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration used by health checks to determine the health of a service.

methods.name: getClusterRolesConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration related to expected cluster roles and their health check settings.
